You can use that feature, if you give the app your permission to localization (GPS) so that the app can determine your start zone. Giving your permission to localization, which is voluntary, can also help you determine your location on the map versus your ticket's validity area.
Monthly passes can be purchased by entering your place of departure and arrival. You can also pick the zones manually on the map if you travel between 2 and 8 zones.

• Zone tickets for 2-8 zones

• Commute20 with Metro and DSB 1’ Regional Train as an optional add-on
• Bicycle Metro
